detail: Operator locates the main entry on Yliopistonkatu, the park entry on the Sorsapuisto side, the rear entry and the auditorium to the right of the main approach.
Municipal cultural inventory identifies 1990 Tampere Hall as the prominent building on the southern edge of Sorsapuisto and records its retained architectural character.
The engineers of the later extension document added space and changes to foyers, auditoriums, exhibitions and an additional glass function hall.
Building engineering survey describes the three building phases and the ceramic brick exterior.
Operator records a rooftop garden and small greenhouse installed in 2016.
